test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A class of 40 students took a mathematics test. 18 students had an average score of 75. The other students had an average score of 62. What is the average score of the entire class?
solution:
Given:

18 students had an average score of 75

The other students had an average score of 62

No. of student = 40

Concept used:

The sum of variables/No. of variables = Average of variables

Calculation:

Let the total average be x.

The sum of 18 students = 18 × 75

⇒ 1350

The sum of the remaining 22 students = 22 × 62

⇒ 1364

40x = 1350 + 1364

40x = 2714

⇒ x = 2714/40

⇒ 67.85

∴ The average score of the class is **67.85**
